data.nationality_rule: REGION:non-European scientists and European junior scientists
data.other_hard: first university entrance qualification within 8 years (96 months) before the application deadline; must start doctoral project or have just started, preliminary results not expected; no more than 6 months since project start at deadline
data.evidence_sentence: Target Group Outstanding European junior scientists who want to do research worldwide, and non-European scientists wishing to do research in Europe.
data.notes: Target group text describes European and non-European junior scientists rather than a list of eligible nationalities, so nationality_rule is a best-fit REGION label; host country not stated as a single country (research at internationally leading laboratory, Germany and US examples given); page is a DAAD listing and the award may be described for the whole programme; criteria include outstanding academic record, research proposal quality and laboratory excellence; minimum GPA not stated; deadlines listed as 1 February, 1 June and 1 October each year; funding amounts include base amount 1,650 EUR plus country allowance; priority/selection criteria not treated as requirements.
